note: Checkpoints for the whole-Moon products (north-polar LDEM_80N_20M and LDEM_60N_60M, cylindrical LDEM_128 and any SLDEM2015 mosaic) and for the seams between products. Written and committed BEFORE any of these was measured; not to be edited afterwards. The commit time is the authoritative time of writing.

checkpoint_1_checksums.rule: as data/checkpoints/thresholds.json: every new file exists with the size and SHA-256 recorded in data/manifest/manifest.json, and every data file was re-read from its second source (the PDS Geosciences Node when it came from the MIT mirror) with an identical SHA-256

checkpoint_2_georeferencing.reference: LOLA RDR laser returns of the 13 LRO_SM_06 files already used for the south (thresholds_independent.json, part B); SHOT_FLAG = 0

polar_north.model: as thresholds_independent.json displacement_model (translation, rotation about the pole, radial scale)

cylindrical.region: returns with |latitude| <= 59.5 (and <= 89.5 for LDEM_128 in a second, reported-only run)
cylindrical.model: d = c + g_east * T_east + g_north * T_north, g from central differences of +-1 pixel in local east/north metres; least squares over |d| <= 50 m (10 x pixel for LDEM_128) and 0.02 <= |g| <= 0.5; block bootstrap over 1 x 1 degree blocks

checkpoint_3_values_and_reference_radius.label_min_max: polar files: measured minimum and maximum DN equal DERIVED_MINIMUM and DERIVED_MAXIMUM exactly (as for the south). Cylindrical files carry MINIMUM/MAXIMUM keys that need not be the extremes of the file (LDEM_16: label MAXIMUM 21580 DN, file maximum 21371 DN, seen while working on the spot heights): the measured extremes must lie inside [MINIMUM, MAXIMUM]
checkpoint_3_values_and_reference_radius.reference_radius: every label: A = B = C axis radius = OFFSET = 1737.4 km; MoonTerrain refuses products with different reference radii
checkpoint_3_values_and_reference_radius.published_spot_heights: data/checkpoints/thresholds_spot_heights.json, for every product that covers the points

polar_60m_vs_LDEM_128.method: as thresholds_independent.json part A (cells of LDEM_128 against the mean of the polar product over the cell), 20 000 cells per band

SLDEM_vs_LDEM_128.method: LDEM_128 cell against the mean of the SLDEM mosaic over the cell

moon_terrain_continuity.method: 2000 points on each boundary where MoonTerrain switches product (edge of the 20 m squares, edge of the 60 m squares, and the +-60 deg edge of SLDEM when present); heights 0.5 m on either side of the boundary along the boundary normal, at max_pixel_m = None
moon_terrain_continuity.tile_seams: inside a mosaic: points 0.5 m either side of every tile edge; the jump must not exceed 1 m (bilinear interpolation is continuous across tiles)
